description_html: Senior Manager, Technical Program Manager      Do you love driving complex technical initiatives and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs.      We are seeking  Technical Program Managers  who are passionate about marrying technology with business strategy to join our team. As a Technical Program Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving major technical transformations and scaling platform capabilities across Capital One.      What You’ll Do:     As a Senior Manager of Technical Program Management (TPM), we’re looking for someone that can help us lead programs that deliver on critical business goals and build large scale products & platforms that will help Capital One customers to have incredible experiences.      In addition to the technical program, you will also work to pave the way for an expanding TPM discipline within the team, by leveraging your industry knowledge and experience to teach the organization what a great TPM can achieve.     Own the operational framework for program execution and roadmap transparency, including dependency mapping, risk escalation pathways, and platform governance routines    Partner with engineering leaders to influence technical decision-making, ensuring platform scalability, resilience, and long-term maintainability    Establish program-wide visibility and accountability through metrics, dashboards, and executive communication cadences    Drive alignment between product strategy and engineering platform capabilities by coordinating across multiple LOB stakeholders       Basic Qualifications:      Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field     At least 5 years of experience managing technical programs       Preferred Qualifications:      5+ years of experience designing and building solutions using distributed computing or service oriented architecture (SOA)    3+ years of experience in building distributed systems & highly available services using cloud computing services / architecture - preferably using AWS    3+ years experience building highly scalable products & platforms    3+ years of experience with Agile delivery    3+ years experience delivering large and complex programs - where you contribute to the business or technical vision, collaborate with large cross-functional teams, secure commitments on deliverables, and unblock teams to land business impact    Experience in building systems & solutions within a highly regulated environment    MBA or Master’s degree or higher in a related technical field (Computer Science, Software Engineering)    PMP, Lean, Agile, or Six Sigma certification    Experience driving cross-platform architecture decisions in cloud-native, microservices-based environment    Exceptional communication and influence skills, capable of engaging deeply with technical teams while translating implications into compelling business narratives that persuade senior leadership          At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (e.g. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, E-3, and O-1, or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).        The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.    Chicago, IL: $182,500 - $208,300 for Sr. Manager, Technical Program Management    McLean, VA: $200,700 - $229,100 for Sr. Manager, Technical Program Management    New York, NY: $219,000 - $249,900 for Sr. Manager, Technical Program Management    Richmond, VA: $182,500 - $208,300 for Sr. Manager, Technical Program Management                                Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.    This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.    Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the     Capital One Careers website  . Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.    This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.    No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.  Capital One promotes a drug-free workplace. title: Infrastructure Engineer
description_html:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring Infrastructure Engineers to build the platform every ElevenLabs team ships on. From the GPU clusters that train and serve our models to the cloud platform our product teams build on, you’ll own the infrastructure that millions of users and thousands of businesses depend on.

You’ll work directly with research, product, security and safety engineers to launch new infrastructure, scale it as their needs grow, and lead the migrations and platform improvements that make it more reliable, secure and cost-efficient.

 - Run and scale Kubernetes clusters, including GPU clusters for inference and training, across cloud and on-prem.

 - Set up compute, networking, permissions and access for other teams as they grow.

 - Host and operate the data systems product teams depend on.

 - Build the tooling, automations and services that make infrastructure self-serve for the rest of the company, mainly in Python.

 - Take on large efforts, such as cluster builds and cloud migrations, and see them through end to end.

We’re a flat team, so you’ll be hands-on from day one. You have strong opinions about doing things right, and you can still move fast when parts of the stack aren’t perfect.




REQUIREMENTS

 - Deep, hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production at scale.

 - Strong experience with GCP, including designing, building and migrating cloud infrastructure end to end as an individual contributor.

 - Strong Python skills and a habit of solving infrastructure problems with code and automation.

 - Experience operating stateful systems (databases, Kafka) on behalf of other engineering teams.

 - Solid fundamentals in infrastructure as code, security and permissions, and the pragmatism to prioritise what matters in a fast-moving environment.

Bonus: experience with GPU clusters or ML training/inference infrastructure (e.g. vLLM), on-prem/bare-metal or deep networking experience, or open-source contributions in the cloud-native community.




LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: ServiceNow Solution Architect
description_html: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for  all .    Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.     Key Responsibilities    1. Solution architecture and design governance   Own end-to-end architecture for assigned ServiceNow products — from discovery and design through release, adoption, and lifecycle improvement — producing artifacts such as blueprints, integration patterns, and decision records.    Lead architecture reviews and design-authority forums for assigned products; approve designs within delegated authority and escalate enterprise-wide or exception decisions to the Platform Architect.    Establish platform guardrails, reusable patterns, and coding/integration standards, and review internal and vendor designs for alignment, security, and technical-debt impact.   2. Demand intake, product ownership, and prioritization   Serve as the functional/technical owner for assigned application areas and primary platform-facing partner to business Product Owners.    Qualify and shape new ideas, enhancements, and technical debt into ready features, epics, and stories, using a transparent value-based prioritization method (e.g., WSJF).    Represent assigned products in Demand Board, roadmap, and release/funding discussions.   3. Integration, data, CMDB/CSDM, and AI architecture   Design integration approaches (IntegrationHub, APIs, events, MID Server) and define data ownership, quality, and lifecycle expectations for assigned products.    Apply CMDB/CSDM, Service Graph, and service-modeling principles where relevant, and guide adoption of Now Assist, AI agents, MCP, and related AI governance patterns.   4. Delivery enablement and platform-health stewardship   Partner with developers, analysts, and vendors to remove technical blockers; build prototypes/proofs of concept and perform code and integration-pattern reviews.    Provide selective quick-turn fixes for executive or critical US-hours needs and first-pass technical triage for severe issues, without owning the incident queue or on-call rotation.    Maintain the product architecture roadmap, support upgrade/release planning, and prioritize technical debt and platform-health improvements; mentor developers on reusable patterns.   5. Business partnership, adoption, and vendor leadership   Facilitate discovery/design workshops, demonstrate capabilities in business terms, and convert underused licensed capabilities into adoption opportunities.    Provide technical direction and design governance to implementation partners and vendors, validating deliverables and ensuring knowledge transfer to operations.     Required Qualifications    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.    8+ years of enterprise platform/application delivery experience, including 5+ years hands-on ServiceNow experience across architecture, configuration, integration, and lifecycle ownership.    Proven ownership of solution architecture in a large enterprise (multiple business units, tenants, or regions), translating business goals into scalable, secure, and supportable designs.    Experience leading architecture reviews, setting standards, and influencing senior business and technical stakeholders.    Current hands-on knowledge of Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, scoped applications, JavaScript, ServiceNow APIs/REST/SOAP, and security controls.    Agile product delivery experience (backlog refinement, prioritization, release planning); strong communication skills; able to work from Boise across US and global time zones.    Experience with the latest ServiceNow AI out of the box and non-ServiceNow capabilities including MCP, Tools, AI Studio, Now Assist Skills, Agents, A2A interactions, Agentic workflows and orchestration and similar.    Architecture/implementation experience across ServiceNow domains such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, CMDB/CSDM, AIOps, CSM, CRM, HRSD, SecOps, or SPM.    Experience with Service Graph, Discovery, Service Mapping, and CMDB governance/data certification.    Experience integrating ServiceNow with enterprise ERP/HR/CRM/identity/security systems in a 24x7 global environment, including release automation, deployment, and instance/clone governance.     Certifications    ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) — required or expected shortly after hire; Certified Application Developer (CAD) strongly preferred.    Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Certified Master Architect (CMA) highly valued; relevant Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certification(s) for the assigned portfolio preferred.    ITIL 4 Foundation and Agile product certification (e.g., SAFe POPM, CSPO, PSPO) preferred.        As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future.  We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget.  Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave.  Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays.   For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on         micron.com/careers/benefits       .     Micron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.
